scenes.say: Let's build a Formula One track right in the middle of Las Vegas.
First you close the streets and line them with concrete blocks.
It's normal city asphalt with manholes. In the very first practice in twenty twenty-three, a manhole cover was ripped out under a Ferrari.
Second practice was delayed two and a half hours while every manhole on the lap was checked and secured.
The race runs at night, so you put floodlights all the way around the lap.
The main course is the run down the Strip: almost two kilometres flat out.
The result: six point two kilometres and seventeen corners, right between the casinos.
See every track of the season in 3D on LapRadar.

title: How to build an F1 track in Las Vegas
caption: Concrete blocks, manholes, floodlights and 1.9 km down the Strip. Every track in 3D: lapradar.com
